note: Campground at Menno Lake, about two miles northwest of Menno, run by the Lake Menno Development Association; the City of Menno lists it but says it is not city-run. Restroom and drinking water, beach, boat dock and Heritage Memorial Park. The dump station and fresh-water fill are in town by the football field (559 S. Park St). No phone is published. --Claude
summary: City of Menno page (current): Menno Lake = 10 electric pads, $15 drop box, FCFS, closed Nov 1-Apr 1, run by the Lake Menno Development Association (not the city). Stored data mixed in the in-town City Park camping (6 pads, 50 A, water, bath house, $25). Fees 10->15, sites 10, season 04-01..10-31 added; electric 50/water hookups/showers/dump cleared (were the City Park's); potable water added. Ownership question flagged. Note rewritten.
flags: OWNERSHIP: City of Menno's page says 'Menno Lake Camping - not affiliated with the City of Menno'; its older page names the 'Lake Menno Development Association' as the operator. Stored 'local' looks wrong: an association-run campground is 'private' under the p3-231 rule (Wabash & Erie) unless the land is public - who owns the lakeshore land was not found. At $15 it passes the price gate either way. Google Maps 'Lake Menno Campground': 3.8 stars from 5 reviews (under 25 - not a quality trigger), no phone, no website.

INCLUSION_EVIDENCE is wrong: it describes the City Park pads ('50/30/20-amp electric, water hookups (added 2025), sewer dump, bath house (2015); $25/night ... closed Nov 1-Apr 1'). Replacement: 'City of Menno Camping Facilities page (read 2026-11-22): Menno Lake - 10 camping pads with electric hookups, restroom, potable water, beach, boat dock; $15/site/night at the campground drop box; FCFS; camping restricted Nov 1-Apr 1; Esri shows a row of gravel pads by the boat dock with RVs on them -> real drive-in campground'.
FEES conflict between the city's two pages: current Camping Facilities page $15 and 10 pads; older Lodging/Camping page $10 and 9 pads. Wrote $15/10.

PRESENCE: the only web presence is the City of Menno's page (stored website, kept - it is the only page with the campground's terms); no phone published anywhere (the older page names a private individual's number - not copied). Note says none is published.

PIN: stored 43.26259,-97.60880 = Google's pin, on three tree-shaded pull-offs along the north shore road (RVs on them in imagery). A second, larger row of ~9 gravel pads with two small buildings sits ~220 m WSW by the boat dock (centre ~43.2616,-97.6112). The page does not say which are the 10 electric pads; under 250 m either way, pin left.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept (defaults down): the shore-road pull-offs at the pin are ~15-25 m from the water behind a continuous tree band; the boat-dock pad row is ~30-45 m from a shallow inlet arm behind a fence/track line and ~70 m from the main lake across the day-use gravel lot. A lakeview is possible from the dock-row pads - weak lead only.

LEAD (not vetted, not in campgrounds.json): Menno City Park camping, north end of the City Park on the west side of Menno - 6 pads with 50/30/20 A electric and water hookups, sewer dump, bath house (2015), $25/night, FCFS, pay at City Hall or paygov.us; city phone (605) 387-2427; same mennosd.org Camping Facilities page.
